digest.component_or_area: generated artifact marking and drift gate CI
propositions: Two JSON-derived files (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack any marker identifying them as generated, causing authors to edit the committed artifact instead of its source, triggering drift gate failures and wasting CI iterations
JSON surfaces cannot carry comment-style banners like markdown files, so they require a top-level _generated_by reserved key as a fixed-point marker that the generator itself emits
The marker must survive byte-identically across regeneration (fixed-point property) to keep drift gates green; stripping it would fail the gate and worsen the situation

Two existing tests that assert on-disk equality against build_prompt_index() must be re-pointed at build_index_document() (the marker-bearing wrapper) while leaving pure-builder invariant tests untouched
A new test must parse docs/README.md's generated-artifacts table and verify every derived surface listed carries its marker, catching future omissions at the table or file level
load_catalog() must skip underscore-prefixed keys so the reserved _generated_by marker never becomes a phantom reviewer, leaving the catalog semantically unchanged
